INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
CSRF_HEADER_MISSING: The request is missing the client header. Refresh the page and try again.
NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed sign-in attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes.
EVENT_NOT_FOUND: This event could not be found.
EVENT_SLUG_TAKEN: This URL slug is already used by another event.
EVENT_CATEGORY_CODE_TAKEN: Category codes must be unique within an event.
EVENT_ALREADY_PUBLISHED: This event has already been published.
EVENT_NO_CATEGORY: Add at least one category before publishing.
EVENT_CATEGORY_INCOMPLETE: Some categories are incomplete. Complete them before publishing.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. The limit is {maxMB} MB.
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only JPG, PNG or WebP images are allowed.
REGISTRATION_NOT_READY: Registration can't be opened yet. Fix the items listed below.
PRICE_RULE_LOCKED: This price tier already has registrations, so its price, audience and categories can't be changed.
TELEGRAM_AUTH_INVALID: We couldn't verify your Telegram sign-in. Close the mini app and open it again in Telegram.
CONSENT_INVALID: The consent form has changed or not every item is checked. Refresh and confirm again.
COUPON_INVALID: This coupon code can't be used.
COUPON_EXHAUSTED: This coupon code has been fully used.
PRICE_TIER_SOLD_OUT: The current price tier just sold out. Please check the price again.
ORDER_EXPIRED: This order has passed its deadline. Please register again.
PROOF_TXN_REF_USED: This transaction reference is already used by another payment proof or receipt. Check it and try again.
RECEIVED_AMOUNT_TOO_LOW: The received amount is less than the amount due ({amountDue}). Reject the proof as an amount mismatch instead.
field.received_before_order: The received time can't be earlier than when the order was placed.
field.slug_format: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. phnom-penh-half-2026.
field.category_code_format: Use up to 10 uppercase letters or digits, e.g. 21K.
field.cutoff_before_start: Cut-off time must be after the start time.
field.event_not_published: Publish the event before opening registration.
field.missing_price_rule: These categories have no price tier: {categories}.
field.missing_payment_account: There is no active USD payment account for this event's registration.
field.ends_before_starts: The end time must be after the start time.
field.quota_below_taken: Can't be lower than the {min} spots already taken.
field.coupon_code_format: Use 3–32 uppercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, e.g. EARLY_2026.
field.percent_range: The percentage must be between 1 and 100.
field.too_young: Must be at least {minAge} on race day.
field.category_unavailable: This category isn't available right now.
field.coupon_invalid: This coupon code can't be used.
ALREADY_REGISTERED: A participant is already registered for this event.
TOO_MANY_UNPAID_ORDERS: You already have the maximum of {max} orders awaiting payment. Pay for them or wait for them to expire before placing a new order.
PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: Payments are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This submission doesn't match the earlier request. Please refresh the page and try again.
ORDER_STATE_CONFLICT: This action isn't allowed for the order's current status.
field.duplicate_id_no: The same ID number appears twice in this order.
field.already_registered: This ID number is already registered for this event.
notify.payment_deadline_reminder: Order {orderNo}: payment is due by {deadline}. Please complete the transfer and upload your payment proof, otherwise your spot will be released.
notify.order_expired: Order {orderNo} was not paid in time and has been cancelled. Your spot has been released. Please register again if you still want to take part.
notify.reject_code.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Amount does not match the amount due
OTP_PHONE_INVALID: Enter a valid phone number with country code, e.g. +85512345678.
OTP_PHONE_NOT_ON_TELEGRAM: This number isn't registered on Telegram, so we can't deliver the code. Use another number or open WeRun inside Telegram.
OTP_SEND_FAILED: We couldn't send the code right now. Please try again shortly.
OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired or doesn't exist. Request a new one.
OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
RACEPACK_NOT_PAID: Payment is not verified yet, so the race pack can't be issued. Send the runner to support or the payment desk.
RACEPACK_ID_REQUIRED: Check the runner's ID in person before issuing a Cambodian-rate race pack.
RACEPACK_NOT_PICKED: This race pack hasn't been issued, so there is nothing to undo.
REFERRAL_SLUG_TAKEN: This referral link address is already taken. Pick another.
COMP_CLOSED: This event isn't accepting complimentary entry requests.
COMP_REQUEST_EXISTS: You've already applied. The organizer will review it.
COMP_REQUEST_REVIEWED: This request has already been reviewed.
COMP_QUOTA_FULL: All complimentary places are taken. Raise the quota first.
field.url_format: Enter a link starting with https:// or http://.
QUALIFY_REVIEWED: This qualification proof has already been reviewed.
QUALIFY_NOT_CONFIRMED: The registration isn't confirmed yet (unpaid or cancelled). Review it after payment is confirmed.
QUALIFY_FALLBACK_FULL: The category to move into is full. Raise its capacity first.
QUALIFY_BIB_ASSIGNED: This runner already has a bib. Void the bib before moving them.
QUALIFY_NO_FALLBACK: This category no longer requires qualification and has no category to move into. You can only approve.
field.qualify_too_slow: You need a time of {max} or faster for this category.
field.refund_tier_order: Days must go from largest to smallest, and the refund can't rise closer to race day.
field.fallback_chain: The category to move into can't require qualification itself, and a category others move into can't become an elite category.
